scenarioTitle: Demonstrate Compliance and Audit Readiness — standards registry, independent applicability, coverage without inference, reproducible signed export, truthful boundaries

criteria.statement: A registered ISO/IEC 42006 publication is an immutable, versioned fact classified as certification-body criteria — audit-readiness, NOT an organizational conformity duty.
criteria.observedVia: publicationDutyClass(PUBLICATION_42006, false) over the frozen fixture publication fields (domain oracle)
criteria.negativeControl: were the tenant an approved certification body the class would flip to 'organizational_obligation' — the class is a computed fact of the publication, not a label

criteria.statement: The standards importer admits a hypothetical future ISO/IEC 42007 draft as immutable, deterministic publication facts — without asserting any tenant conformity.
criteria.evidence: imported 1 pub / 1 clause; digests stable=true; duplicate threw StandardsImportError
criteria.observedVia: importStandardsSeed(futureSeed, NOW) — the real application standards importer
criteria.negativeControl: a duplicate identifier@registryVersion seed throws StandardsImportError — the registry never silently overwrites or double-registers a fact

criteria.statement: An independent, activating review turns a proposed applicability decision into an ACTIVE, superseding decision; a self-review never activates.
criteria.observedVia: reviewApplicability(...) + applicabilityIsActive + applicabilityVersionSupersedes (application service + domain oracles)
criteria.negativeControl: a reviewer==proposer verdict yields rejectionCode=NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_REVIEWED and an inactive decision — self-review can never activate applicability

criteria.statement: A not_applicable decision whose review instant has lapsed REOPENS its coverage gap; the coverage engine surfaces it as reopened_non_applicability.
criteria.negativeControl: an active, in-window applicable decision (DECISION_READY) does NOT reopen a gap (false) — only a lapsed non-applicability reopens

criteria.statement: A control whose evidence is stale surfaces a stale_evidence gap and caps the boundary BELOW ready — current operation is never inferred from stale evidence.
criteria.evidence: stale boundary=operating, gaps=["stale_evidence"]; ready boundary=ready, complete=true
criteria.observedVia: reconstructCoverage('stale') vs reconstructCoverage('ready') — claimBoundary + gaps + complete (coverage engine)
criteria.negativeControl: the READY scenario (current, sufficient evidence) has zero gaps and reaches ready+complete — the gap is a fact of the stale evidence, not of every scope

criteria.statement: The claim boundary is truthful: internal readiness reads ready; only a valid, displayable external certification reaches certified; an expired certificate NEVER promotes readiness to certified.
criteria.observedVia: reconstructCoverage over the READY / CERTIFIED / EXPIRED-CERT input bundles — claimBoundary (coverage engine)
criteria.negativeControl: the EXPIRED-cert scope has the identical readiness picture yet stays ready (never certified) — an out-of-window certificate cannot lift the boundary

criteria.statement: Evidence + obligations are tenant-isolated: authorizing references for TENANT excludes every OTHER_TENANT reference, and TENANT coverage never includes another tenant’s obligation.
criteria.observedVia: authorizeReferences(refs, TENANT) + reconstructCoverage('cross-tenant') (audit-export filter + coverage engine)
criteria.negativeControl: authorizing the SAME refs for OTHER_TENANT keeps only OTHER_TENANT rows and excludes 2 TENANT ref(s) — isolation is symmetric, not one-sided

criteria.statement: The audit export is a signed, tamper-evident, byte-reproducible package whose gaps are copied verbatim, whose cross-tenant references are excluded, and whose truthful external-claim note is always present.
criteria.observedVia: buildAuditExportPackage → verifyManifest + custodyChainIsIntact + body.gaps + body.referenceCount (audit-export builders)
criteria.negativeControl: reversing one custody link breaks custodyChainIsIntact AND verifyManifest; corrupting the manifest body digest fails verifyManifest — any tamper is detectable

criteria.statement: A nonconformity finding retains its due date and surfaces as overdue when lapsed; its corrective action requires a root cause, and closure requires a verified-effective review.
criteria.observedVia: raiseFinding → findingOverdue → openCorrectiveAction → reviewEffectiveness → closeCorrectiveAction (corrective-action service predicates)
criteria.negativeControl: a corrective action with no root cause is refused (MISSING_ROOT_CAUSE) and a still-open finding past due reads overdue — closure is never inferred

criteria.statement: A management review is recorded with participants + inputs on a declared cadence, and a lapsed cadence is surfaced as due — never inferred as still-current.
criteria.evidence: lapsed review cadence lapsed=true; current review cadence lapsed=false
criteria.negativeControl: a review held 5 days ago on the same quarterly cadence reports NOT lapsed — lapse is derived from the cadence + held instant, not asserted
